name: Kalshi BTC executable outcome quote
description: Full-replacement executable quote and most recent trade for one bound Kalshi market generation. The feed's YES bid and ask are preserved; NO bid equals one minus YES ask and NO ask equals one minus YES bid under the pinned binary-contract price axis. No cross-market value survives a market_transition boundary. Ready output requires a ready rules card plus two-sided ticker and trade inputs. While the venue is alive — any book, quote, trade, or contract input admitted within staleness_bound_ms (10000 ms) — an unchanged resting book republishes its held quote values and stays ready, while a genuinely silent venue and every integrity fault (crossed or invalid quote, missing input, market-boundary rule) still degrade unchanged. Quote age uses monotonic receipt time. Decimal values are rounded to at most eight places using round-half-to-even.
